Trump-Xi summit provides 2-3 week risk-on window. Fed hike digestion continues. Expect volatility around Hormuz diplomacy headlines.

US-China normalization supports global growth. Structural copper/silver tightness supports commodities. Consumer spending moderation favors essential over discretionary.
